svg.title: Nagarajan Thathasamy — ASCII portrait and SecOps stats
svg.desc: Left: an ASCII-art portrait of Nagarajan Thathasamy drawn line by line in a terminal running ./portrait.sh. Right: ./stats.sh --secops showing 3+ years in the SOC, 40,000+ endpoints defended, 1,000+ alerts triaged per month, 1.6M+ events searched in under a second, 7,000+ leaked secrets surfaced and a 40% cut in critical-vulnerability backlog, followed by his security tool arsenal.
svg.text: monitoring · every alert is a lead
